PZZ700-201015-
143 PM PST Thu Nov 19 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1018 mb high was 100 nautical miles southwest of 
Ensenada, Mexico, and a 1004 mb low was over Reno, NV. A cold
front is sweeping through the waters, from northwest to southeast,
generating wind gusts up to 25 kts and choppy 5-8 foot seas
through this evening. Stronger cells within the front could
produce gusty/erratic winds and even a waterspout. Wind and seas
diminish gradually overnight into Friday morning. Weaker onshore 
flow will follow Friday afternoon, with offshore flow Saturday. 
Weak onshore flow returns Sunday, increasing Sunday night into 
Monday.
